summary: The diff modifies 12 files but does not show evidence of the two core requirements being implemented: (1) REQ-1 requires cache invalidation of the feed query after a successful createVideo mutation in the Upload page, and (2) REQ-2 requires fixing backend persistence/retrieval in backend/main.mo. The frontend-file-summaries.txt mentions Upload.tsx was modified to fix field names and enum values, but does not mention cache invalidation. The backend/main.mo diff is truncated and shows no clear evidence of a persistence fix. Neither the useQueries.ts hook diff nor any Upload.tsx content shows invalidateQueries being called for the allVideos query key on successful upload.

missing_requirements.requirement: After a successful video upload via the Upload page, the feed React Query cache must be invalidated or refetched after the createVideo mutation completes successfully, so the new video appears without a manual page refresh.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary for useQueries.ts mentions various hook additions but does not mention cache invalidation for the feed/allVideos query after createVideo/useUploadVideo mutation success. The Upload.tsx summary only mentions fixing field names and enum values, with no mention of onSuccess cache invalidation. No evidence of invalidateQueries for allVideos or equivalent being added.

missing_requirements.requirement: The backend createVideo function must correctly persist the uploaded video to stable storage and return it in the getVideos feed query immediately after creation.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff is truncated and only shows type definitions and imports. There is no visible evidence of a fix to the createVideo persistence logic or getVideos retrieval logic. The file-summaries.txt does not mention any backend fix.
